audit.why: missingInteractions is empty; the page already covers the turret-zone poke, the Encore counter to his ult setup, and the CH-2 stun bait with real ability names.

edits.before: Q-poke the contacts and count your notes — every third spell sings twice.
edits.after: His turret field and Q autos out-zone your weak level-1 poke; step up and you eat turret damage for nothing.

edits.before: W-sustain trades begin: the duo shield-heal makes even exchanges dishonest.
edits.after: Turret field plus W rockets punish any step-up you make; his zone control snowballs before your kit comes online.

edits.before: E-chains open: slow into root is the lane's longest pick at 3.
edits.after: Full turret uptime at 3 walls you off the wave — his stationary damage denies CS and trades alike.

edits.before: Echo economy: bank the third-cast for the spell the moment wants doubled.
edits.after: Layered turret damage through 4-5 still denies your CS; his zone holds until your kit catches up.

edits.before: First item spike: echoed Qs chunk and the note ledger compounds.
edits.after: First item lets you out-range his poke with layered Q and E slows — a real all-in threatens his stationary kit.

edits.before: Late Seraphine conducts teamfights: charm the formation, echo the heals, and root whatever the wave spares.
edits.after: Late, your AoE shield/heal and Encore chain-CC outscale his turret-bound damage in fights.

edits.before: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade (Stun): matchup-defining — The stun makes his turret nest lethal — dodge it before committing anything. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Beat Drop for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: CH-2 Grenade (E) is a flat 11s cooldown at every rank — punish that window, not just when you see the throw. His turrets (Q) recast every 1s but cap at two, so breaking one drops the zone fast. Budget your E for the stun, not chip.

edits.before: Echoed Q the contact, W the trade-back, E the disengage — the song taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.
edits.after: Your W shields first, then echoes into a heal — cast it into his turret chip to outlast the stalemate without losing tempo.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W out of rhythm — the third note is the champion; wasting it is singing scales.
edits.after: Encore only converts groups pinned near his turret nest — cast it on an empty wave and you hand him a free reset.
